findings.rule: D41/D42: a short skill keyword is confirmed only when stated as a whole token, never inside a symbol-joined token
findings.trigger: SKILL requirement text 'Knowledge of C++ and R&D tooling, go-to-market' with keywords [C, R, Go] and a null detail: answerSkills returns ['C','R','Go'] (verified by running it). containsWord only guards letters and digits, so C matches in C++, R in R&D, Go in go-to-market and the skills.added list gains skills the user never saw.
findings.title: containsWord confirms C, R, Go inside C++, R&D, go-to-market
findings.proof: Add to test/tailormyresume-answer-facts.test.ts a case with text 'Knowledge of C++ and R&D tooling, go-to-market', keywords ['C','R','Go'], detail null, expecting []. It fails today.

findings.rule: Issue 95: an answer bullet may be cited by an entry only when the detail names its organisation or title
findings.trigger: entriesNamedIn uses a raw substring test. Entry organization 'EY' and detail 'They led the key project' returns the entry (verified by running it), so an EY bullet may cite the answer bullet although the detail never names EY. No test covers whole-word naming or the title branch.
findings.title: Entry-name match is a substring, so short or common names attach the answer to the wrong entry
findings.proof: Unit test: entriesNamedIn('They led the key project', [{id:'E',organization:'EY',title:'Analyst'}]) must be []; and a title-only match test ('I worked as a Data Analyst') must return the entry.

findings.rule: Golden prompt unchanged when no answer; tests must be able to fail
findings.trigger: The loop calls reset() once before it, so generatorPrompt() reads generator.doGenerateCalls[0], the first (null) iteration's call, in both iterations. The omitted-answer iteration never inspects its own prompt, and a leak of ans- text in that case would pass.
findings.title: 'answer null or omitted' checks the stale first call for the omitted case
findings.proof: Move reset() and the grants inside the loop, then assert on the prompt of each iteration.
